experiment.linked_execution: Resident owns the container verifier, linked loop and continuation. One pinned LANGVM exports its existing raw-image kernel and I/O services; no second VM is linked into resident firmware.
experiment.source_changes: Only the owned candidate autoexec.m61 is replaced by reinit/loadfont/vm-linked. A and control use the original dispatcher. The source programs are unchanged; LVP chunks exist only in B, ordinary derived pages only in A/control, avoiding artificial competition in C9's bounded record area.
experiment.compiler_bootstrap: Frozen previously qualified BASIC/FOCAL/LANGIN/SRCEDIT APPs, byte-identical in all stages. The measured LANGVM is the same new 20476-byte experimental image in A/B/A. Bootstrap frontend compilation is excluded from the warm comparison.
experiment.code_identity: All 16 ordinary published cached modules used by this search are byte-identical to their LVP members (full images, source/bytecode CRCs and SHA-256 checked).
experiment.physical_storage: 12 ordinary <=4096-byte C9 binary chunks, not a larger native APP or increased per-inode limit.
experiment.cache: Uses the existing 32-KiB resident page cache, immutable per-member raw loans and the existing 4176-byte compiler prefix; numeric banks stay in their original 4016-byte tail.
experiment.scope_limitations: First Classic PoC: <=29 catalog entries, <=8-KiB resource-free LBV2 members, unlimited whole-member kernel calls, .RE=99 external return. INPUT expression/editor APP handoff and general dependency refresh are not yet integrated. Generic host/ARM session tests still cover INPUT and step-budget yields.

budget_evidence.footprint_comparison: Same source tree, toolchain, features and diagnostic setting; only MK61_LINKED_VM_POC=0 versus 1. This is an experimental Flash cost, not a zero-Flash optimization.
budget_evidence.APP_pool_gate: PASS with full 2560-byte stage index, 8264-byte MSC session and 824-byte filesystem temporaries
budget_evidence.resident_VM_duplicate: No language_vm::run symbol in resident ELF; kernel resides only in LANGVM.

results.comparison: Median of repeats 1 and 2 per stage; first search excluded for all stages. Ordinary first searches create the derived file cache; the LVP image is prebuilt offline, so their cold difference is not claimed as matched execution speedup.
results.conclusion: The linked resident loop saves about 2.15 seconds per warm search (8.58%), not 2x. This first PoC pays about 10.24 KiB resident Flash and is not enabled by default.

previous_attempt.reason: DWT diagnostic command was compiled out; HIL correctly refused timing without its stopped-profiler/cache-counter checks.
previous_attempt.fix: Enable the existing DWT diagnostic interface, keep profiling stopped during timing; no checks or budgets relaxed.

setup_findings: The first 5FA83672 attempt omitted the prof command and was correctly rejected before timing; original firmware/files/state were restored exactly.

Keeping an unused LVP package alongside the ordinary derived cache made the control fail compilation. Removing the unused artifact let the same ordinary path complete (39.622 s cold); likely C9 record-space pressure. This is an inference, not a newly proven compiler defect.

A slow transfer command occasionally received a truncated ASCII reply; an existing fast SourcePort polling method is now opt-in for setup/recovery only. Measured TimedScreenPort and all CRC checks remain unchanged.

A damaged COBS frame aborted another attempted control. That run contributes no timing. The separated-artifact A/B/A continues to require every packet/frame CRC and the complete golden eight-rank board.
M61 errors now abort the HIL launcher immediately, covered by a regression test, instead of waiting for a search timeout.
hardware_speedup_claim: Matched A/B/A above, same resident and byte-identical LANGVM, byte-identical used LBV2 images; verified after exact restoration. No production enablement, commit or merge.
